facts.fact: Burundi Eco reports the Ministry of the Interior presented on 6 May 2026 one digital platform for managing civil status documents and producing the future biometric national ID card.
facts.system: plateforme numerique d'etat civil and carte nationale d'identite biometrique

BDI.note: No count or share enrolled; card is not yet issued.
No number at birth is mentioned.
Telecom operators are named as technical partners for connectivity only; no operation or maintenance role is stated.
The unique number is to be used in official documents including the passport; no public register keyed on it is named.

facts.fact: Burundi Eco reports the biometric national ID project is in a pilot phase in about a dozen communes, to be extended nationwide, with a legal framework still to be revised.
